messages:
Riley: Hey team — trying to enroll my ThinkPad into company MDM. Intune shows 'awaiting BitLocker enable' and the installer prompts for a recovery key. Any guidance?
Jordan (IT): Welcome! For Windows we require BitLocker. Can you run `manage-bde -status` and paste the serial (`wmic bios get serialnumber`) so I can check the device record?
Riley: Serial: S0MP12345678. manage-bde output: 'No key protectors found' and 'Protection Status: Off'.
MDM-Bot: Device S0MP12345678: Intune enrollment: pending-complete, assigned profile: corp-windows, BitLocker: not enabled, last-checkin: 2026-08-02T14:05:12Z. Recovery key escrow: none.
Jordan (IT): Thanks. We can push an Intune policy to enable BitLocker (TPM-only) and escrow the recovery key to Azure AD. I'll deploy 'enable-bitlocker-TPM' now. You'll likely see a UAC prompt when the script runs.
Riley: Please push it. I'm at my desk.
Jordan (IT): Policy pushed. Watch for a consent prompt and accept. After it completes run `manage-bde -status` again and paste results.
MDM-Bot: Policy 'enable-bitlocker-TPM' deployed to S0MP12345678 (initiated by Jordan (IT)). Recovery key escrow to Azure AD initiated.
Riley: UAC prompt appeared, accepted. Running `manage-bde -status` shows 'Protection Status: On' and 'Percentage Encrypted: 100%'. I can also see a recovery key under my Azure AD device page.
Jordan (IT): Perfect. I'll log this action (ticket IT-5500) and close the loop. If you need TPM+PIN instead, we can update the policy. Welcome aboard!
Nora: Welcome Riley — ping me if you want VPN or dev tooling help.
